_template: PROPOSED, NOT BUILT, as missionboard26a: a board mission whose one place is an orbit. Eliza's.
_deal: The board's test node, until he plays it.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-26 07:12, variations on 26a: "enemy ship.has part, get and take to sat"
_note: THE SPACE BOARD FAMILY, 3: THE STOLEN PART. A ship hit the supply run and kept the satellite's replacement part. It is
still in orbit. Take it apart, recover the part from what's left, fit it. The one with a fight.
NEEDS A BEAT NOBODY HAS BUILT: a hostile SHIP as a defeat target in orbit. The defeat beat today spawns an Npc or
LeveledNpc on the ground. But the space shell was cut from a shipped remote-space quest whose target IS a ship
(delve-recipes.md, Space), so the ship half may be closer than it looks. Eliza's to price.
THE PART COMES OFF THE WRECK, A RECOVER: 'takes item off whoever has it (loot, pick up, be handed it: all count)'.
A destroyed ship drops its cargo to loot, which is the vanilla way. Recover is refused on a board today; hers.
Boarding the ship instead of destroying it is the other way to 'get' it, and a bigger build; not written.
The broadcast plays at the ship, his 1500 m. Closing line on the radio. Pay: med, capped.

place._orbit: As 26a: the orbit is the board's target, field name Eliza's.

prose.name: Recovery: Stolen Part over <Planet>
prose.briefing: A ship hit the supply run to the communications satellite over <Planet> and kept the replacement part. It hasn't left orbit.
prose.card: Recovery contract. A ship stole the replacement part for the communications satellite over <Planet> and is still in orbit. Deal with the ship, recover the part and fit it to the satellite. Payment on contract completion.

beats._target: A hostile ship, levelled, whatever the space shell's own target ship is or Eliza's pick. Not an Npc.
beats.objective: Destroy the ship that took the part
beats.journal: The ship that hit the supply run is gone. The part should be somewhere in what's left of it.

beats.objective: Recover the power regulator from the wreck
beats.journal: I took the power regulator back off the ship that stole it. It needs fitting to the communications satellite over <Planet>.
say: That's our part. Now get it to the satellite before anyone else gets ideas.

beats.objective: Fit the power regulator to the communications satellite
beats.journal: A ship stole the communications satellite's replacement part and sat in orbit over <Planet> with it. I took it back and fitted it. The satellite is back on.
beats.name: Communications Satellite

message.title: Satellite Repaired
message.text: The regulator seats and the satellite powers up. Its channels open, one by one.

say: We're back on. Every channel's open. And I don't think anyone's going to try that again.

broadcast: That's them. They hit our supply run and kept the part. They won't hand it over. Take that ship apart and the part should come out with the rest of their cargo.
_speech: The operator is angry and practical, which is why the voice is Clara (Direct, Firm and Confident), already in four recipes; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency.
